//ConnectionStrings: In dev the SQL Server DefaultConnection is normally supplied by Google Secret Manager (dbserver/dbusername/dbpassword composed automatically). The values below are only an offline fallback if Secret Manager is unreachable; real credentials come from Secret Manager or env vars.
//GoogleSecretManager: Dev pulls DB secrets from the GCP project below, filtered to secrets labelled env=dev. Auth uses Application Default Credentials — sign in locally with `gcloud auth application-default login` (or set GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS to a service-account key file); nothing is committed. The dbserver/dbusername/dbpassword secrets are composed into a SQL Server connection string automatically.
